rooms.name: Dungeon Entrance
rooms.description: You stand at the entrance of a dark, foreboding dungeon. Cold air seeps from the stone walls, and the faint sound of dripping water echoes ahead. A narrow corridor stretches to the north, and a passage leads east to what looks like an armory.

rooms.name: Armory
rooms.description: Racks of rusted weapons line the walls of this old armory. Most are beyond use, but a few items still look serviceable. A passage leads west back to the entrance, and stairs lead north to a guard room.

rooms.name: Dark Corridor
rooms.description: A long, dimly lit corridor stretches before you. Scratch marks cover the walls, and you notice small bones scattered on the floor. The passage continues north toward a crypt, and the entrance lies to the south.

rooms.name: Guard Room
rooms.description: This room once served as a guard post. A broken table sits in the corner, and old torches hang from the walls. Passages lead south to the armory and west toward a crypt.

rooms.name: Ancient Crypt
rooms.description: Crumbling stone sarcophagi line the walls of this ancient crypt. The air is thick with dust and the smell of decay. A heavy iron door to the north bears strange runes — it leads to the Shadow Vault. Passages lead south to the corridor and east to the guard room.

rooms.name: Shadow Vault
rooms.description: You enter a vast underground chamber. Dark energy crackles through the air, and shadows writhe along the walls. At the center of the vault, a towering figure of living darkness turns to face you — the Shadow Lord.
